column1: # Source: the Windows keyboard layout 00000429 ("Persian"), read from the operating system with
# dump.ps1 (Win32 ToUnicodeEx on the layout, Windows Server 2025 build 26100, 2026-11-09).
# It is data, not a table typed from memory: every later change of it is a diff a reader can
# compare with a fresh run of dump.ps1. The generator (gen/main.go) turns it into
# ../layouts_gen.go, and TestLayoutTablesAreGenerated fails if that file drifts.
# Columns, tab separated: scan code (hex), then four code point lists ("U+0041+U+0042" is
# two characters): the key on the US layout (00000409) unshifted and shifted, and the key on
# this layout unshifted and shifted. An empty cell is a key with no character. The US legend
# is what a Persian letter is "read as" (4.3): the key it shares with a Latin letter.
